name: macrofactor-data
description: Read your imported MacroFactor nutrition and training data and check its freshness.

interface.longDescription: Read your MacroFactor exports, including food nutrients, daily nutrition, weight and workouts. Check the connection and latest imported dates before relying on the data. This plugin is for reading and analysis.
defaultPrompt: Check my MacroFactor connection and data freshness.
Review my nutrition over the last seven days.
Show the nutrients in my recent food log.
